title: a slow kilometre
description: Walk one kilometre at a pace where you can still talk. Your route is the proof.

title: a two-minute plank
description: Hold a plank for two minutes, breaks allowed. Film the last ten seconds.

title: a snack neither of you has had
description: Walk the food court in MacEwan Student Centre and choose a snack or drink neither of you has tried. Split it, and photograph it before the first bite.

title: find the 1988 rings
description: The Olympic Oval was built for the 1988 Winter Games. Find something nearby that still shows it, and take a photo of the two of you with it.

title: a poster for something this week
description: Walk to the Rozsa Centre and find a poster for a performance or talk coming up. Photograph it, and each pick the one you'd actually go to.

title: the oldest book on the floor
description: Pick one floor of the Taylor Family Digital Library. Between you, find the book with the oldest publication date on an open shelf, and photograph its title page.

title: the view from the top
description: Find a window on the top floor of TFDL that faces the mountains. Photograph the view and agree on one thing you can both see.

title: City Wildlife
description: For 20 minutes, take pictures of as many wildlife animals as you can with 1 point for birds, 3 points for rodents, and 5 points for large mammals.

title: Animal Bingo
description: See how many of these you can take a picture of in 5 minutes. Animal sleeping, a baby animal and it's mother, an albino animal, swimming animal, crying child.

title: Prince's guess
description: Set a 10 minute timer, in that time you can wander anywhere and do anything other than looking it up online. Make a educated guess with the other person, who ever gets closer wins.

title: God Damn Dam
description: Starting at the dam, one person position themselves some distance away such that they believe the other person could find them and take a photo in 10 minutes. Then swap roles. See who can estimate the hiding time better.
